body: A wildcard identity namespace (e.g. cluster-wide service token) overrode the OpenFeature evaluation context's namespace/targeting key with `*`. Downstream, this `*` no longer matched the caller's concrete auth namespace, causing flag evaluation requests to be rejected as a namespace mismatch. This falls back to the instance's own namespace (or `default`) whenever the identity namespace is empty or `*`, so eval context stays concrete and consistent with what the caller is actually authenticated as.
title: OpenFeature: Don't let wildcard namespace override eval context
